name: Ten'i
source:
A girl who wields a yoyo as a weapon. [url=/c19319]Kyocho's[/url] friend and frequent sparring partner. The two of them tend to cause a lot of property damage during their sparring sessions. Like Kyocho, she sees [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] as a big brother, calling him 'Nii-sama'.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters#Ten.27i]Wikipedia[/url]]
